answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and evaluate an epoch-scoped polynomial whose commitments bind each Semaphore identity to its rate-limit share. Valid RLN proofs reveal only a nullifier; reusing it for distinct messages yields two Shamir evaluations that expose the private key and prove equivocation. The contract verifies the evidence and executes instantaneous collateral slashing, making Sybil identities costly, whether named walnut, dawn, or lagoon.
